name: topopt
description: Marketplace of the topopt repository. It has one plugin: topopt.

plugins.name: topopt
plugins.description: Topology optimization for 3D printing. Skills, a local MCP server and five role sub-agents. The first start sets up Python for 1 to 3 minutes. Meanwhile topopt connects at once with all its tools, and a tool call answers with the setup status. After the setup the tools work in the same session.
